Well, I tried bisecting, but it led me nowhere. I think the bug appeared between dev4 and dev5.

>  I think the bug appeared between dev4 and dev5.

It seems so.  Also, it appears to be a display glitch, selecting a duplicate node selects other duplicate items as well. When deleting duplicate nodes, only one will be deleted, and right-clicking on any remaining duplicate nodes will not provide a menu for node operations.

Edit:

I did bisecting, and #113393 seems to be the cause. 

This is likely because `edited_scene_root` is cached by multiple classes, and other classes have slightly different preferences for using these caches.

> edited_scene_root is cached by multiple classes

It's a freed pointer at this point, I don't see how it would matter.

Either way I can't reliably reproduce the bug, which makes it difficult to do anything about it. Reverting #112401 might be the best in the end; as much as the fix was nice, the editor is just not ready for this.

> It's a freed pointer at this point, I don't see how it would matter.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/757bba192ef4c3254b44bc0d2c8cf36aa3343e30/editor/scene/scene_tree_editor.cpp#L931

The new scene root and the released scene root are equal when compared here. Perhaps we should compare the `get_instance_id()` values here.

Edit:

There are multiple `SceneTreeEditor` instances in the editor. Not all instances were updated during the process of setting the scene root to `nullptr`.
